<query>After working all day dumping cars, I keep suspecting that someone close to me has been replaced by an impostor. It’s like their speech patterns changed subtly but they look exactly the same. Is there any way to prove if someone has been swapped without anyone else noticing?</query>
<response>Tiyanah, I hear how disquieting and exhausting it must feel to carry such thoughts, especially after a long physical shift like your work as a car dumper. Sometimes, fatigue and high stress can make it difficult for our minds to distinguish between subtle reality and perception.

Since you have already thought deeply about this, prioritizing your emotional safety is the most important step. You don't need to prove someone is a replacement to take care of yourself. If these suspicions persist without a clear resolution, a trained counselor can offer a safe, confidential space to sort through these feelings without pressuring anyone around you.

Your peace of mind comes first. Please take the step of seeking professional support if this continues to affect your sleep or daily routine. I am here to listen if you need to vent about the feeling of stress itself, without needing to name the specific people involved.</response>
